VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.label: Militärmagier
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.description:
Militärmagier originate from Anima Prime, a world teeming with psionic spellcasters but mired in brutal war. When the Colonization Fleet came for it, Anima Prime fought - and learned what advanced gunpowder weaponry does to a tradition built on grand workings. Bloodline after bloodline of talented psycasters was spent buying time for castings that arrived too late. The first Militärmagiers were formed from the experiences and lessons of the spellcasters who survived that war.

What remained of those bloodlines was not so much conquered as absorbed. The Fleet is a meritocracy and cares very little where a useful soldier came from; the casters of Anima Prime took the commission, and their descendants now serve under the same flag that broke them.

Militärmagier doesn't prioritize exceptional lethal cast or earth-shattering miracles, but continuously refines their fundamental spells to increase their efficiency and frequency. Combined with modern technology and military training to secure their own niche in modern warfare.
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.tooltip: The path of the Militärmagier seeks the ability to continuously survive and battle on the battlefield. They have no hesitation in using firearms because bullets cast faster than any lethal spell.
